$comment: Run O1 lane K1 batch b7: series data for Sailor Moon (tier C), built from pinned Wikipedia revisions (franchise article, TV series article, Sailor Moon Crystal article, character list), Wikidata Q1643098 (manga), Q704353 (1992 anime) and Q16138249 (Crystal), and the official anime site sailormoon-official.com (read directly; it credits Naoko Takeuchi and Toei Animation). Facts are drafts for review. This one series file covers three works and questions must say which: the manga (1991 to 1997), the 1992 Toei anime (200 episodes) and Sailor Moon Crystal (2014 to 2016, 39 episodes). The five arcs are the manga's story arcs named in the Wikipedia chapter list and the Crystal article (Dark Kingdom, Black Moon, Infinity, Dream, Stars); Wikipedia says the five arcs match the five seasons of the 1992 anime, so the episode ranges are the 1992 anime's (46, 43, 38, 39, 34 episodes; ranges from the Wikipedia table). Crystal covers arcs 1 to 3 only (Death Busters is its name for Infinity), and its films Eternal and Cosmos cover Dream and Stars. No chapter ranges are stored: the chapter list numbers 60 serialized chapters and 52 reorganized acts and the arc ranges differ between them. Character debut arcs follow the arc in which the character first appears per the Wikipedia plot summaries (Chibiusa in Black Moon, Haruka and Michiru in Infinity). spoiler_level equals the debut arc for those who debut after arc 1; Mamoru is tagged 1 with identity_spoiler because the Tuxedo Mask reveal is a story beat. Native names come from the Wikipedia character lists; Queen Beryl has none stored because the page spells it クイン・ベリル. Themes: the main opening Moonlight Densetsu is one song in two versions (DALI, then Moon Lips, stored as OP 1 and OP 2), then Sailor Star Song, and the finale ending; the other endings are not named with artists in the sources read and are not stored. Status is finished. Official URL is the 30th anniversary site listed on Wikidata.

series.title_native: 美少女戦士セーラームーン

characters.name: Usagi Tsukino
characters.description: A careless but big-hearted middle school girl who transforms into the heroine Sailor Moon.

characters.name: Ami Mizuno
characters.description: A quiet, very bright classmate who becomes Sailor Mercury and hopes to be a doctor.

characters.name: Rei Hino
characters.description: A shrine maiden who becomes Sailor Mars and can ward off evil with ofuda scrolls.

characters.name: Makoto Kino
characters.description: A tall, strong transfer student who becomes Sailor Jupiter and loves cooking.

characters.name: Minako Aino
characters.description: An aspiring idol who is Sailor Venus and first appeared in the spin-off Codename: Sailor V.

characters.name: Mamoru Chiba
characters.description: An older student who also helps the Guardians as the masked Tuxedo Mask.

characters.name: Luna
characters.description: A talking black cat who tells Usagi she is Sailor Moon and guides her.

characters.name: Artemis
characters.description: A white cat who advises Minako Aino and works alongside Luna.

characters.name: Queen Beryl
characters.description: The founder of the Dark Kingdom, the first enemy force the Guardians face.

characters.name: Chibiusa
characters.description: A girl from the 30th century who trains to become Sailor Chibi Moon.

characters.name: Haruka Tenoh
characters.description: A tomboyish race-car driver who transforms into Sailor Uranus.

characters.name: Michiru Kaioh
characters.description: An elegant violinist and painter who transforms into Sailor Neptune.
